items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: she married Marsalis Green, the trumpet player with me then.

ctx.x: Right. And, who else functioned as either a male or a female singer in your band that we haven't mentioned so far?

Dolly Lyons. She is one of the girls. Effie Smith. I got her in California. Oh, Ida James. She was the first girl vocalist I had. She, all those years with Earl Hines - for a short time - (inaudible) Then she was with me about, maybe about 8 years.

DeLores Brown. She did quite a few recordings for me. I got DeLores Brown, she was singing along with Duke along with Ivie Anderson. Duke had two vocalists. They were at Loew's State and I went down to catch Duke. And, I saw them both. I went backstage, this is after hours. I said Duke, you don't need two vocalists. I said I like DeLores there. He said go talk to her if you want her.
